data.name: Nauseating Flesh
data.description: The underground chemist's body is suffused with poison. Any creature that bites, engulfs, or swallows the underground chemist must make a Fortitude saving throw or be nauseated for 1d4 rounds. The underground chemist with this discovery does not suffer the effect of the poison of his own nauseating flesh.
